name: Villanueva de la Jara (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, blue and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de la Jara (a castle, a lion and a jar on blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de la Jara; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villanueva de la Jara arms — castle, lion and jar
